name: Fluent Speech Commands: Spoken Language Understanding Dataset
description: Fluent Speech Commands is an audio spoken language understanding benchmark comprising 30,043 English utterances spoken by 97 native and non-native speakers. Published at Interspeech 2019 by Fluent.ai, each voice command is recorded at 16 kHz and annotated with three slot arguments: action, object, and location.
